Print a compositional variable summary

Source: R/summary_compD.R
print.summary_compD.Rd

Prints a summary.compD() object as a text report, automatically at the console, as base R's print.summary.lm() does. The report describes the composition by its parts, closure (with its unit label, when one was declared), number of observations and how much the raw row totals varied before imputation or closure. It states which parts had zeroes and, if any were imputed, the method used, and how many observations were flagged as compositional outliers when flagging was run. The requested tables follow as plain tibble output.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'summary_compD'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A summary_compD object, as returned by summary.compD().

...

Unused; present for S3 consistency.

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

summary.compD() to build this object; pub_ready() for a formatted gt table.

Examples

cd <- declare_composition(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"),
                          closure = 1440)
print(summary(cd))
#> <compD> compositional variable summary
#>   Parts: MVPA, LPA, SB, SPT
#>   Closure: 1440
#>   Observations: 300
#> 
#>   Row totals (before closure): mean 1440.0 (SD 0.0), range 1440.0-1440.0
#>   No zeroes detected.
#> 
#> Descriptive statistics
#>   geom_mean: imputed, closed composition; other columns: original data
#> # A tibble: 4 × 10
#>   part  label geom_mean  mean    sd median   p25   p75   min   max
#>   <chr> <chr>     <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 MVPA  MVPA       28.1  45.9  44.7   35.0  12.7  61.8   0.1  240 
#> 2 LPA   LPA       235.  243.   86.9  232.  173.  308.   51.8  504.
#> 3 SB    SB        677.  661.  118.   669.  586.  743.  316.  1037.
#> 4 SPT   SPT       499.  491.  106.   489.  426.  559.  240.   815.
#> 
#> Variation matrix
#> # A tibble: 4 × 6
#>   part  label  MVPA   LPA    SB   SPT
#>   <chr> <chr> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 MVPA  MVPA   0    1.67  1.55  1.44 
#> 2 LPA   LPA    1.67 0     0.247 0.260
#> 3 SB    SB     1.55 0.247 0     0.140
#> 4 SPT   SPT    1.44 0.260 0.140 0
